## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmed by broad sector breadth ≥7/11 and visible Financials/Healthcare strength (MA, V, JNJ ABOVE TREND). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in top performers) — Growth/Momentum tilt but concentration raises caution.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong on momentum names: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY. Financials showing cyclical breadth: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND. Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate soft: DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY; NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY; PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND; ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY; APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk despite strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND; LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION; NUE (1W: -11.09% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND; CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND; VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Utilities and select Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: multiple mega-cap Techs (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META) show 1W positive vs 1M negative — tactical momentum but watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but active short-term momentum; several leaders in RECOVERY while key enablers remain BELOW TREND. NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND; PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth positive within the 8/11 regime.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive and a core confirmation of RISK-ON with payments and banks strong: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND; JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION — look for follow-through from buyback/dividend headlines.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive/cyclical support to the market; JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth supportive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and select Healthcare names given broad RISK-ON confirmations; reduce exposure to concentrated Tech momentum where top-5 leadership is narrow. Monitor major-cap Tech RECOVERY names (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL) for confirmation before expanding exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +4.42%) and Financials (1W: +2.73%) — both show ABOVE TREND leaders. BEARISH: Utilities and Energy (both negative this week) — watch for further downside.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY for follow-through above this week’s pivot to validate a durable turnaround; monitor NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND for failure to reclaim 1M slope as a sign of deeper pullback; MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND breakouts would confirm Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JPM (+80): JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION — buyback/dividend news supportive but short-term pullback is a divergence to watch. QCOM (+65): QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND — positive deal flow but price remains in divergence. AMAT (+55): AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION — earnings strength noted; needs 1W stabilization to confirm accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NOW (-45): NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY — analyst skepticism contrasts with strong 1W rebound (divergence). LRCX (-45): LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION — negative sentiment aligns with 1W weakness. CEG (-45): CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both confirm downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Growth/Momentum tilt but narrow leadership concentrated in Technology; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap Tech RECOVERY moves (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META) create a MAJOR divergence vs 1M trends — watch for trend breaks and news-confirmation (e.g., QCOM, AMAT) before enlarging positions.
